body:
## Why

The entire campaign depends on an accurate, attributable 159-county foundation. Establish the historical roster before rendering or balancing territories.

## Scope and acceptance criteria

- [ ] Produce a manifest of exactly 159 unique county identities with official names, stable IDs, historical reference date, and source citations.
- [ ] Crosswalk historical identifiers to modern Census codes without claiming those codes existed in 1942.
- [ ] Inspect Newberry Georgia download metadata and its CC0 terms; record Census provenance and notices.
- [ ] Resolve or document historical changes, including former Campbell and Milton territory; keep unresolved geography out of release-ready status.

## Design reference

[Game design](https://github.com/andysolomon/county-compact/blob/main/docs/game-design.md), sections 3.1–3.2, 12.

## Delivery gate

A — Historical map foundation · P0

## Dependencies

None.

## Validation

Demonstrate the behavior against the acceptance criteria. Add focused invariant/regression checks where data integrity or simulation correctness is at risk. Record historical uncertainty and measured results explicitly.

## Scope boundary

Georgia only; local browser application; bundled runtime data/assets. Do not add later-roadmap systems to this issue.
